tools.name: reg_search
tools.description: FREE. Latest 5 Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, notices) matching a keyword, e.g. 'PFAS', 'overtime', 'crypto'.

tools.name: reg_watch
tools.description: PRO. Documents since a date for keywords and/or agency slugs (e.g. 'environmental-protection-agency') and types (rule, proposed, notice, presidential).

tools.name: open_comments
tools.description: PRO. Proposed rules with comment periods still open for a keyword/agency — deadline first.
